rv.q: Matilda is a fabulous family fizzer.
This generous, big-hearted piece is already being spoken of as one of the best new British musicals in years.
It's an evening of unadulterated bliss.
You'd be a nitwit to miss this hit show.
It is the best new British musical since Billy Elliot.
But the tremendous heart and intelligence of the piece remains undimmed.
Matilda the Musical is nevertheless hugely enjoyable and cracking Christmas fun.

"Warchus’ peerless production...is spectacularly staged. It feels both intimate and larger-than-life as we see the world through the unique prism of the older-than-her-years Matilda, a voracious reader and loner who is neglected by her parents...
Powerful, funny and beautifully musical, it reminds us who we are, and who we might be.
They have created a fresh and intelligent family entertainment that brings joy to both adults and children (crucially never patronising the latter).
But it’s still dark, daring and a lot of fun.
But there are a few bumps in the adaptation by Dennis Kelly, and Tim Minchin's songs are deficient in nothing except melody
Matilda The Musical, produced by the Royal Shakespeare Company, is an explosion of energy, colours, creativity and talent.
Gloriously over the top it’s an irresistible and ingenious mix of fun, fizz, cruelty, incredible choreography and above all warmth which means we root for the kids from the start.
We were both completely blown away by them – they are definitely the stars of the show.
This Matilda is a cunning combination of gross cartoon, pitch-perfect professionalism and endearing feel-good factor.
